title: The Rainbow
introduction: ‘The Rainbow’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects colours in nature, observation after rain, descriptive imagery, patterns and sequence, wonder and curiosity. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.
